title: Re-elected Lok Sabha MPs average declared assets (2014-2024)
definition: Mean total declared assets across three consecutive election affidavits (2014, 2019, and 2024) for 102 MPs re-elected in all three Lok Sabha terms, reflecting property valuation changes, family/spouse holdings, business income, and legislative earnings.

sources.publisher: Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR) and National Election Watch
sources.title: Analysis of Assets Comparison of Re-Elected MPs Between 2014 to 2024 Lok Sabha Elections

points.evidence: Average Assets in 2014 Elections: The average assets of these 102 re-elected MPs fielded by various parties in 2014 was Rs 15.83 Crores.
Average Assets in 2019 Elections: The average asset of these 102 re-elected MPs in 2019 was Rs 24.21 Crores.
Average Assets in 2024 Elections: The average asset of these 102 re-elected MPs in 2024 was Rs 33.13 Crores (10-year growth of Rs 17.29 Crores or 110%).
